description: Adds keywords to an existing rank tracker config. Returns `{ added, addedIds }` — `added` counts only genuinely new keywords; anything already tracked for this config is silently skipped, so `added` can legitimately be lower than the number of keywords sent. FREE: database only, no SEO data provider is called and no credits are spent — but this CAN fail with a plan-limit error if adding these keywords would put the organization over its plan tier's rank-tracked-keywords cap, since that is a count limit, not a spend limit. This does not trigger a rank check or refresh keyword metrics — call get_rank_tracker afterward once you want positions.

keywords.description: 1-100 keywords to add. Duplicates of already-tracked keywords are silently skipped.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: add_rank_tracking_keywords
